correctness.rationale: For uniform iid q-ary W (q>=2,n>=2), the deterministic two-deletion cardinality B_2(w)=binom(r,2)+k-t follows by appending one letter and checking the exact intersection of two deletion-output sets, including overlapping singleton runs. With Xi=1{Wi!=Wi+1}, S=sum Xi, Q=sum adjacent XiXi+1, E=X1+Xm and T=number of ABA interior singleton returns, get B2=binom(S+2,2)-E-Q-T. The initial letter and q-cyclic increments are independent uniform; Xi iid Bernoulli p=(q-1)/q; conditioning on Xi makes each ABA cancellation a constraint on independent nonzero increments. Every subset of the eligible adjacent constraints is a forest, so these indicators are mutually independent Bernoulli a=1/(q-1), proving T|X~Binomial(Q,a), including q=2 degeneracy. Squarefree centered-Bernoulli orthogonal expansion and law of total variance yield the displayed mean and three-term variance for every n, including n=2 zero variance. Independent full output-set enumeration over small q,n confirmed both conditional and moment statements.
